request: Repair failure_fingerprint in the supplied project module. When a traceback contains multiple exception lines, use the final exception as the signature; normalize any 64-character hex digest in that signature. Keep the public function and deterministic SHA-256 result.
requirements: line-number and path differences ignored when exception is unchanged

starting_files.solution.py:
"""Stable signatures for observed validation errors; never generates feedback."""
import hashlib
import re

def failure_fingerprint(feedback):
    lines=str(feedback).strip().splitlines()
    exceptions=[line.strip() for line in lines if re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_][\w.]*(?:Error|Exception)(?::.*)?',line.strip())]
    signature=exceptions[0] if exceptions else str(feedback).strip()[-3000:]
    # Diagnostic digests identify an observation, not the underlying failure.
    signature=re.sub(r'\b[a-fA-F0-9]{64}\b','<digest>',signature)
    return hashlib.sha256(signature.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()

import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from billing.parser import parse_receipts
from billing.report import invoice_totals

def main(argv):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    totals = invoice_totals(parse_receipts(Path(args.input).read_text()))
    Path(args.output).write_text(str(totals))
    return 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main(__import__('sys').argv[1:]))
